name: resizable
description: Panel group whose dividers can be dragged to resize, collapse or restore the adjacent panels.

props.name: direction
props.description: Required. Split axis of the panel group; vertical stacks the panels. Example: direction="horizontal"

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Initial size of a panel as a percentage of the group. Example: defaultSize={30}

props.name: minSize
props.description: Smallest size a panel can be dragged to, as a percentage. Example: minSize={15}

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest size a panel can be dragged to, as a percentage. Example: maxSize={70}

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Allow the panel to collapse to collapsedSize when dragged past minSize. Example: collapsible

props.name: collapsedSize
props.description: Size the panel snaps to while collapsed. Example: collapsedSize={0}

props.name: order
props.description: Explicit panel order inside the group. Example: order={1}

props.name: onCollapse
props.description: Called when a collapsible panel collapses. Example: onCollapse={() => setOpen(false)}

props.name: onExpand
props.description: Called when a collapsible panel expands again. Example: onExpand={() => setOpen(true)}

props.name: onResize
props.description: Called while the panel is dragged, with the new percentage. Example: onResize={(size) => save(size)}

props.name: onLayout
props.description: Called with every panel size whenever the group layout changes. Example: onLayout={(sizes) => persist(sizes)}

props.name: autoSaveId
props.description: Persist the group layout in localStorage under this key. Example: autoSaveId="editor-layout"

props.name: keyboardResizeBy
props.description: Percentage a handle moves per arrow-key press. Example: keyboardResizeBy={10}

props.name: withHandle
props.description: Render a visible grip on the drag handle; the user drags it to resize. Example: <ResizableHandle withHandle />

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevent the handle from being dragged or focused. Example: <ResizableHandle disabled />

props.name: hitAreaMargins
props.description: Extra pointer tolerance around a handle so it is easier to grab. Example: hitAreaMargins={{ coarse: 15, fine: 5 }}

props.name: onDragging
props.description: Called when a drag on the handle starts and ends. Example: onDragging={setDragging}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the group, panel or handle. Example: className="rounded-md border"

props.name: children
props.description: Required. ResizablePanel and ResizableHandle children of the group. Example: <ResizablePanel />
